summary_1line: Celestial sages urge Bharata to honor Rama’s vow; Bharata begs Rama to rule, but Rama insists on exile and instructs Bharata to govern in his stead.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bharata falls at Rama’s feet in the forest assembly, crying out while sages and warriors watch in solemn silence.
Rama lifts the trembling Bharata and embraces him like a swan, surrounded by gathered sages in a woodland clearing.
Invisible celestial sages hover above the meeting of the two princes, praising their virtue as the brothers stand facing one another.
